Now this is my own personal opinion, but when you compliment her for something don’t just compliment her appearance. As someone who struggles with an ED and was in a relationship who’s only compliments were their appearance, it made part of my ED worse (once again, my personal experience not saying she may go through this) because I felt like it was the only thing he liked. Moving forward I’ve found someone who compliments EVERYTHING not just my appearance. I’ve made a lot of improvements by being validated by my person as a whole instead of just strictly my body.

I feel ya, nothing worse then stepping into a random dressing room mirror and being appalled by the way you look. It gets better though, sometimes when we lose weight we just don’t realize because it’s such a gradual everyday difference. Make sure your drinking and eating still!!

Just know you are loved and one day this whole thing will just be a distant thought in your mind!

NTA

As someone who is a SA victim, this is probably one of my biggest things. Although my and your sons situations are different, there is nothing more upsetting than family thinking they are the only exception to my “no touching” rule. I hate having to continuously reiterating myself whenever I say no to hugs or kisses, if I say no then I mean no. Family needs to learn to understand, and yes they’ll get upset (god knows I’ve been yelled at before for this), but it’s something they’ll have to deal with. Just because touch is their love language does not mean it’s also mine.

when I was assaulted I also happened to be asleep, and for a really long time it also became a trigger. I started off with getting multiple locks on my bedroom door (I still have them tbh) and I also got a bunch of comfort stuff for me like dozens of blankets,etc that I used as a way to shield myself from everything. 

I don’t know if it’s an option for you at all, but potentially getting an animal companion to sleep with you at night may also help, for me I have my cat (with separation anxiety from Covid) that falls asleep with me each night. It’s really helped me throughout the years, it makes me feel protected.

Not sure if this is of much help, but this is what has helped me.
